subtasks.description: Investigate various federated learning methods suitable for the federated memory architecture.

<info added on 2025-11-16T22:04:17.043Z>
Following up on Federated Averaging as our baseline, we'll integrate Differential Privacy to heighten privacy levels and support a weighted averaging methodology for equitable data representation based on the size of contributions from each source in federated learning. For robustness against anomalies or outliers within clinical embeddings datasets, median aggregation will also be incorporated into our strategy alongside FedAvg to bolster reliability and accuracy during model training phases under various conditions. Our implementation approach is meticulously designed for a balance between maintaining strong privacy guarantees without compromising the representativeness of distributed data sources across federations in clinical settings, ensuring fairness through weighted aggregation by accounting for differential contributions sizes to mitigate bias and outsized influence.

subtasks.title: Design federated embedding aggregation strategy

subtasks.title: Implement privacy-preserving knowledge sharing mechanisms
subtasks.description: Develop methods for securely exchanging information between clinics without compromising patient data.
subtasks.details:
Research and implement techniques like secure multiparty computation, differential privacy, or homomorphic encryption to protect data during transmission.
<info added on 2025-11-16T22:05:52.301Z>
"Implemented privacy-preserving mechanisms with specific techniques now in place, including Differential Privacy using Gaussian and Laplace noise addition methods to datasets before sharing among federated nodes within HygiaAI's network for secure aggregation of knowledge without compromising patient confidentiality. Secure Multi-Party Computation (SMPC) protocol has been identified as a robust mechanism which will be fully implemented in the future, alongside an initial placeholder setup that allows conceptualizing its integration into our privacy preservation framework by simulating secure computations within isolated environments to ensure sensitive data remains undisclosed during processing. Additionally, Homomorphic Encryption techniques have also been earmarked for inclusion; they are currently being researched and will be incorporated in the coming updates which allows encrypted data to undergo computation while remaining encrypted at all stages thus maintaining high security standards within federated memory architecture without decrypting sensitive patient information during transmission or processing. Furthermore, a configurable noise injection mechanism has been integrated into SecureAggregator allowing for tunability of privacy by setting epsilon/delta parameters that tailor the trade-off between data utility and individual user's privacy risks - ensuring differentially private aggregations are in alignment with federated learning protocol. Sensitivity bounding via clipping has been added to manage variably sensitized patient information thereby mitigating potential overexposure during data sharing processes; this function operates by setting a predefined threshold for sensitive attribute magnitudes, ensuring no single datum exceeds it and thus minimizing privacy risks. The system now includes three preset privacy levels – BASIC, ENHANCED, STRICT - which users can select based on their compliance requirements with regards to data confidentiality within federated learning environments."
</info added on 2025-11-16T22:05:52.301Z>
